// diagnostic

E0227

A function whose parameter is marked `&` or `&&` is used as a value instead of being called.

What

A function whose parameter is marked `&` or `&&` is used as a value instead of being called.

Why

A function type gives each parameter plain read access, so a value of this function would lose the write or take its parameter declares; the function can only be called directly.

Fix

Call the function directly, or pass a lambda that makes that call.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0227: tests/ui/function_value_access_cannot_erase.stderr.

Error [jet.MarkedFunctionValue]: `edit` can't be used as a function value because its parameter `value` is `&`
  --> tests/ui/function_value_access_cannot_erase.jet:10:20
    |
 10 |     edit_callback: edit
    |                    ^^^^
 Why: A function type gives each parameter plain read access, so a value of `edit` would drop the `&` its parameter declares
 Fix: Call `edit` directly, or pass a lambda that makes that call
